title_en: You (O Ali) Are My Successor After Me - Part 29

summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari continues the analysis of traditions establishing Ali ibn Abi Talib as successor after the Prophet.
